reviews.review:
Cant really recommend it at the moment
it's just not there at the moment

enemies can bleed through walls and shoot you through them
enemies can hit you through your shield so whats the point
equipment feels like a waste  of time as none of it really benefits the player all that much grenades can be handy but are so situational 90% of the time you would be better off just shooting anyway 
and don't even get me started on how generic and uninspired it is 
the same level over and over  I mean its the same neon corridor/square over and over literally for the first part of the game anyway I sure hope the more I play it changes because currently i have only seen the same tile sets repeated over and over even after killing the first boss (what I assume was a boss two elite heavy soldiers  who where about as challenging as a wet fart when you are already sat on the toilet) 

Melee is strong, I mean to the point it does way more damage than any gun i have found, the guns them self are boring and the gun play is wonky as hell, your bullets kinda feel like they curve if you are strafing and it throws my aim off so badly which I will admit is a skill issue on my part I guess I have to adapt to it one of the issues I have with the gunplay is that if something gets on camera behind the player it can make you hit it rather than where you are aiming this is most prevalent on the big square pyramid tile set when jumping down the railings behind you can make you shoot backwards 

then lets talk about the dash, why even bother you can use it and still have the enemies hit you but if you are strafing they cant seem to aim at you and just spray your direction very bizarre also the dash is so short that you are better just sprinting if you are using it to get out of blast zones 

I love games like this and I really hope they can make it better or that it gets better later on because currently my experience is  walk into  room, kill 5 drones, 5 pistol guys, 5 beam rifle guys 2 machine gunners 2-5 shields  over and over  

I am hoping that that my first impressions of this game are just bad and I can learn to love it  and that certain things get fixed but as it stands I would give this one a pass for now might be better with friends but solo its a drudge and just not fun

also god the levels are just too short, 2-3 rooms + a trial  I mean its like playing a phone game 

I came to this game hoping for a cyberpunk style gunfire reborn but its not there its not even close 

Despite a litany  of issues I have with the game its not a bad game and the bones are there for a good game just don't know if it is enough to keep me entertained
played the first 4-5 levels and every level/enemy type looked the exact same, game crashed and i ended up refunding it.
game got it's early access title removed so no new content is going to be added last was in may 2023, so please pass this game, it's a pretty decent game but the makers just left the game to die
Well polished game with awesome difficulties. A game to play with friends.
